Replace.Text: 城市不会产生厌战情绪。占领城市时，所有军事单位的体力值将完全恢复。
Cities do not incur war weariness. All military units heal completely when capturing a city.
Qin Twenty Ranks of Noble Titles

获得双倍厌战情绪，发动突袭战争、领土扩张战争、解放战争或被宣战时10回合 +2 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。每种政体具有额外的军事政策槽位，每个军事政策槽位提供+1 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力和+5 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持。陆地单位击杀单位时获得 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力50%的 [ICON_Culture] 文化值，如果被击杀的是非蛮族单位额外获得 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力25%的 [ICON_GreatGeneral] 大将军点数。

Double the war weariness. When you declare a Surprise War, a Territorial Expansion War, a Liberation War or are declared war on, +2 [ICON_Movement] Movement for 10 turns. Each government has an additional Military policy slot, and each Military policy slot provides +1 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength and +5 [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor. When a land unit kills a unit, gain [ICON_Culture] Culture equal to 50% of its [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength; if the killed unit is non-Barbarian, also gain [ICON_GreatGeneral] Great General points equal to 25% of its [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength.
解锁法典市政后可宣布领土扩张战争。宣布领土扩张战争后的10回合内+2 [ICON_Movement] 移动力、+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。

Can declare a War of Territorial Expansion after gaining the Code of Laws Civic. +2 [ICON_Movement] Movement and +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength for the first 10 turns after declaring a War of Territorial Expansion.
